title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-30
content:
Morning notes (2026-02-24):
- Quick wins: bumped GPU pool capacity on eu-west-1 by 2 g4dn nodes (manual) to handle spike from customer X. Need to automate.
- TODOs:
  1) Finish autoscaling policy for dedicated-gpu-pool (ticket INFRA-1423) - add cooldowns + scale-down grace = 10m
  2) Follow up with networking on ENI limit in us-west-2 - hit 85% yesterday; open quota request if we see two more spikes
  3) Patch nodes with NV driver 535.86 -> schedule maintenance windows and canary on staging
  4) Add dashboard tile: per-model KV-cache hit-rate (for Optimize team)
- Commands/cheat-sheet:
  - list GPU nodes: kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide
  - cordon + drain: kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
  - check driver: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
  - capture logs: journalctl -u kubelet -n 500 > /tmp/kubelet-logs.txt
- Incidents / recent anomalies:
  - 2026-02-22: kernel panic on gpu-node-17 during long-running batched inference. Symptoms: oom-ish, NV driver stack trace in /var/log/kern.log. Suspect driver + memory leak in our batched runtime.
    - Actions: repro with stress test (gpu-batch-stress.sh), collect coredump, attach to INFRA-1423, escalate to NV driver bench team if repro.
  - 2026-02-18: brief latency tail on long contexts (4k tokens) on model-bert-22; suspected KV cache misses + hot-shard on eu-west-1 cluster.
- Capacity snapshot (rough):
  - total GPUs company-wide: ~420 (prod: 300, staging: 70, dev: 50)
  - reserved for Dedicated contracts: 120
  - 7d 95th pct GPU util (prod): 62%
  - current spare capacity (prod): ~35 GPUs (should keep >= 20 for bursts)
- Notes for automation tasks:
  - Autoscaler: need a predictive headroom policy (1m qps moving avg + 95p latency) vs current reactive rules.
  - Pre-warm nodes for large-batch jobs (customers using long-gen): hook into job scheduler to request capacity 5m before start.
- Networking reminders:
  - ENI quota in us-west-2 creeping up; talk to infra-net (Anya) about moving some staging nodes to a different AZ to spread ENI usage.
  - Check iptables rules after kernel update (2 nodes had DROP rules added by mistake last week).
- Runbook updates to make:
  - add step to run stress script when upgrading NV driver (so we catch kernel panic repro early)
  - update rollback doc for driver upgrades: automatic reimage path + restore kubelet config
- Open blockers / questions:
  - storage perf regression when starting >100 concurrent long-gen jobs. Is this NFS saturation or controller? Follow up with storage team (PR #234).
  - need decision on whether to increase Dedicated reservation by 10 GPUs for Q2 upsell. Cost impact analysis needed.
- Meeting notes / schedule:
  - Sync with Release Eng tomorrow 09:30 to plan rolling kernel+driver update (staging canary on Feb 26)
  - 11:00 triage: go through INFRA-1423 repro results, assign owners
- Misc scratch/ideas:
  - try predictive autoscale prototype (train simple model on qps trend) -> lightning test in staging
  - consider offering "burst pool" as Dedicated add-on (ops: reserve hot nodes, bill on usage) - discuss with Lina from Product
- Notes to self:
  - keep daily list short, triage tickets at 11:00, ping Marcus for driver rollout approval, attach repro logs to INFRA-1423.

End of scratchpad entry.
